legenda: Modern Brazilian bossa nova, intimate and gently wistful mood, soft male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese with a warm breathy voice, nylon-string classical guitar with syncopated bossa comping, brushed snare, warm upright bass, light Rhodes chords, soft flute fills, rubato guitar-and-voice bridge, close-miked warm production, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: A espera de quatro minutos por um bloco de microaula vira o tempo de um café numa bossa nova, enquanto o Emanuel compara modelos para encurtá-la.
descricao: Bossa nova com violão de nylon sobre o Mentoria, que gera microaulas a partir do arquivo do professor e quer encurtar os quatro minutos por bloco.
